key.name: ac-power-profile
key.description: Power profile applied automatically upon transitioning to AC power. Manual changes in Quick Settings remain respected until the next power state transition.

key.name: ac-lid-action
key.description: Action performed when the laptop lid is closed while connected to AC power.

key.name: ac-lid-ignore-external-monitor
key.summary: Apply AC lid action even with external monitor connected
key.description: When false, closing the lid while an external display is connected keeps the laptop awake in clamshell mode.

key.name: ac-idle-action
key.summary: Automatic suspend action when plugged in
key.description: Synced directly to org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-type when not set to unchanged.

key.name: ac-idle-timeout
key.summary: Automatic suspend delay when plugged in (seconds)
key.description: Synced directly to org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-timeout.

key.name: ac-screen-blank
key.summary: Screen blank delay when plugged in (seconds)
key.description: Value in seconds synced to org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay on AC transition. -1 leaves it unchanged; 0 means never.

key.name: battery-power-profile
key.description: Power profile applied automatically upon transitioning to normal battery operation.

key.name: battery-lid-action
key.description: Action performed when the laptop lid is closed while running on battery.

key.name: battery-lid-ignore-external-monitor
key.summary: Apply battery lid action even with external monitor connected
key.description: When false, closing the lid while an external display is connected keeps the laptop awake in clamshell mode.

key.name: battery-idle-action
key.description: Synced directly to org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-battery-type when not set to unchanged.

key.name: battery-idle-timeout
key.description: Synced directly to org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-battery-timeout.

key.name: battery-screen-blank
key.description: Value in seconds synced to org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay on battery transition. -1 leaves it unchanged; 0 means never.

key.name: low-battery-power-profile
key.description: Power profile applied automatically upon entering low battery state.

key.name: low-battery-lid-action
key.description: Action performed when the laptop lid is closed while on low battery.

key.name: low-battery-lid-ignore-external-monitor
key.summary: Apply low-battery lid action even with external monitor connected
key.description: When true, forces the configured low-battery lid action even if an external monitor is connected.

key.name: low-battery-idle-action
key.summary: Automatic suspend action on low battery
key.description: Temporarily applied to sleep-inactive-battery-type while in low battery state, and restored upon leaving low battery.

key.name: low-battery-idle-timeout
key.summary: Automatic suspend delay on low battery (seconds)
key.description: Temporarily applied to sleep-inactive-battery-timeout while in low battery state.

key.name: low-battery-screen-blank
key.summary: Screen blank delay on low battery (seconds)
key.description: Value in seconds synced to org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay on low battery transition. -1 leaves it unchanged; 0 means never.

key.name: sleep-mode
key.description: Determines whether lid-close Suspend uses Standby (RAM), Suspend then Hibernate, or Hybrid Sleep.

key.name: low-battery-mode
key.description: Use UPower's system WarningLevel (recommended) or a custom battery percentage threshold.

key.name: low-battery-percentage
key.description: Battery percentage at or below which Low Battery state activates when low-battery-mode is set to percentage.

key.name: pause-media-on-suspend
key.summary: Pause media players before lid-triggered suspend
key.description: Sends an MPRIS Pause command to active media players before suspending or hibernating on lid close.

key.name: unplug-while-closed-mode
key.description: Use the built-in default grace delay (3 seconds) or a custom number of seconds.

key.name: unplug-while-closed-grace-seconds
key.summary: Custom grace delay when unplugged with lid already closed (seconds)
key.description: Delay before applying the battery lid-close action if AC power is disconnected while the laptop lid is already closed.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Display transient GNOME notifications when Power States switches modes or encounters a backend issue.

key.name: recovery-state
key.summary: Internal: atomic JSON recovery journal for managed native GNOME settings
